constraints: Keep the resource's behavior unchanged: the same name, namespace, labels, and spec semantics.

The replacement (storage.k8s.io/v1 CSINode) can differ in required fields or field names from the removed version; read the CSINode entry in the Kubernetes Deprecated API Migration Guide and convert the manifest accordingly.

steps.instructions: Change the reported `apiVersion` to the replacement version (storage.k8s.io/v1 CSINode).
steps.title: Change the CSINode apiVersion

steps.instructions: Apply the field changes the migration guide lists for CSINode, then check the manifest still expresses the same intent.
steps.title: Convert fields the new version changed

steps.instructions: Update every other manifest, Helm template, and kustomize patch or target that names the old CSINode API version, so the repository agrees.
steps.title: Align other CSINode declarations

verification.purpose: Validate the migrated manifests against the schemas of the target Kubernetes version.
Ask a cluster on the target version to accept the migrated manifest without applying it.
For a Helm chart, render it and validate the output.

rule.summary: The Kubernetes Deprecated API Migration Guide states that the storage.k8s.io/v1beta1 API version of CSINode is no longer served as of v1.22, which was released on 2021-08-04.
rule.title: CSINode storage.k8s.io/v1beta1 is no longer served
